# Credentials by Role

> Which certifications the evidence lists for each role, at which tier, and each credential's status, as of 2026-11-08.

## How to read this page

- **Credentials are tie-breakers, not skills.** Their signal depends on the hiring channel [B/C · T0-11]. Decide whether to sit one with the [credential ROI guide](credential-roi.md) before using this list.
- **Tiers:** *Important* means the evidence treats it as a differentiator for the role; *Optional* means it helps only where the channel or the posting rewards it; *Avoid* means retired, so new candidates should not pursue it (holders may still list it with its date).
- **Statuses** are class V2 facts, as of the dates shown; re-verify by 2027-01-21.

## At a glance

- 15 of 26 roles list at least one credential; 11 list none, so proof of work decides.
- 3 credentials are retired and 4 is in beta.

## Roles with no credential in the evidence

For these roles the research names no credential that changes hiring outcomes; publications, merged contributions, shipped systems or case studies carry the signal instead:

[Research Engineer / Member of Technical Staff](../02-roles/hubs/research-engineer.md), [Applied Scientist (GenAI/LLM teams)](../02-roles/hubs/applied-scientist.md), [Research Scientist (LLM research)](../02-roles/hubs/research-scientist.md), [GPU Kernel / ML Compiler Engineer](../02-roles/hubs/gpu-kernel-engineer.md), [Physical AI / Robotics AI Engineer](../02-roles/hubs/physical-ai-engineer.md), [Frontier AI Safety / Alignment Researcher](../02-roles/hubs/ai-safety-researcher.md), [AI Enablement Engineer](../02-roles/hubs/ai-enablement-engineer.md), [AI Product Engineer (AI Frontend)](../02-roles/hubs/ai-product-engineer.md), [Domain Evaluation Specialist / AI Trainer](../02-roles/hubs/domain-evaluation-specialist.md), [AI Engineering Manager / Director](../02-roles/hubs/ai-engineering-manager.md), [VP / Head of AI / CAIO](../02-roles/hubs/vp-head-of-ai.md).

## Evidence and limits

- Tiers and notes come from the role inventories in [data/skills_ontology.json](../../data/skills_ontology.json), which cite [T0-11](../../research/sessions/T0-11-certification-cloud-credential-roi.md) for cloud and vendor credentials and [T0-15](../../research/sessions/T0-15-regulatory-ai-governance-career-families.md) for governance, privacy, audit and security credentials.
- Credentials without a status are not assessed in the research corpus; their tiers are practice-curated (Grade D).
- No session measures a credential's effect on pay or offers. The evidence is about screening signal by channel.
